seo.title: Request a Titanium Dioxide Quote | TiO2 Malaysia
seo.description: Request a titanium dioxide quotation from TiO2 Malaysia by providing your grade, application, quantity in metric tonnes and destination for review.

hero.heading: Request a Titanium Dioxide Quote
hero.body: Tell us the product, application, quantity and destination you are evaluating. Our team will review your requirements and prepare the appropriate commercial response.

form.heading: Quotation request details
form.intro: Required fields are marked. Please use business information and avoid confidential formulations, account credentials, payment details or sensitive personal information.

summary.heading: Please review the highlighted fields.
summary.body: Correct the information below and try again. Your other entries are still here.

errors.grade_empty: Select a product or grade, or choose “Not sure / Need help.”
errors.destination_too_long: Keep the destination country to 100 characters or fewer.
errors.port_too_long: Keep the destination port or city to 120 characters or fewer.
errors.company_too_long: Keep your company name to 160 characters or fewer.
errors.contact_too_long: Keep your name to 100 characters or fewer.
errors.email_invalid: Enter a business email in the format name@company.com.
errors.phone_too_long: Keep the phone or WhatsApp number to 40 characters or fewer.
errors.website_invalid: Enter a complete website address or remove this optional value.
errors.requirements_too_long: Keep additional requirements to 2,000 characters or fewer.

helpers.port: Add this only if it is already known.
helpers.email: Use the business email where we can respond to this request.
helpers.requirements: Add any non-confidential specification, packaging, schedule, document or other context that may help us review the request.

privacy.lead: We use the information you provide to review and respond to your quotation request.

failure.heading: Something went wrong while submitting your request.
failure.body: Your information is still here. Please try again.

unavailable.heading: The quotation request form is temporarily unavailable.
unavailable.body: No request has been submitted. Please return later and try again.

otherRequests.heading: Other request types
otherRequests.body: Use the separate request form when you need a sample review or controlled document request instead of a quotation.
